Good to know

On iPad or iPhone, choose Photo Library in the picker. Your video plays locally and is never uploaded. Safari may need one tap on Play after selection.

Add to Home Screen: open this page in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Your speed is remembered; choose your video again each time you open the app.

MOV and HEVC playback depends on your device and Safari. Unsupported videos need a compatible copy; SlowMo does not convert them. Full screen keeps the custom speed and loop controls over your video. Tap the video to hide or show them; double-tap the left or right half to skip. Skip duration is saved on this device. Mirror flips only the picture. Loop delay counts real seconds between A/B repeats; Pause cancels the countdown. Fit shows the whole video; Fill crops the edges. If automatic full-screen entry is blocked, tap Full screen. If container full screen is unavailable in your browser, SlowMo tells you; it never switches to the native video-only player.

Compare: choose a practice video, pause each video on the same beat, then Sync here. Shared controls use the overlapping section. Practice hides only the reference picture; its music keeps playing. Practice & Record can optionally show the reference beside your camera; use Show / Hide reference during a take. Recording uses one fixed-speed pass, then automatically maps the take for comparison. Recordings automatically save on this device in SlowMo when browser storage permits. Save to Photos / Share opens the iPad Share Sheet; choose Save Video if offered. Done returns to Watch inside the player. Use Save / Share explicitly to export; system sharing can leave native fullscreen. Local browser storage is not your Photos library and can be cleared; export important takes. Sections saves named A/B loops locally; select the same original video again to restore them. Edited copies or cleared browser storage may lose the match. Compare → Export comparison makes a local side-by-side video with the current sync and mirrors. Export the active section or full overlap at normal or current speed, with reference music or silence. Keep SlowMo visible during real-time export (up to 5 minutes / 100 MB). MP4/H.264 is preferred; WebM fallback has more limited Photos compatibility. Browser capture is not frame-exact; review important exports. Camera permissions, audio routing and sharing depend on iPadOS. If camera capture interrupts reference audio, the take stops rather than silently losing synchronization.
